propDocs.MotionStyleSwitcher.preference: Motion preference instance; the default applies and saves the choice globally.
propDocs.MotionStyleSwitcher.orientation: Horizontal or vertical arrangement and keyboard navigation.
propDocs.MotionStyleSwitcher.disabled: Disables changes to the selected style.
propDocs.MotionStyleSwitcher.readOnly: Retains focus and browsing while preventing changes.
propDocs.MotionStyleSwitcher.required: Requires a selected style when used in a form.
